name: app-header
title: App header
description: The lab's header: breadcrumb taste-lab / <lab> / <round menu>, icon-only page toggles and theme switch in a 56px top bar, and on Compare a round tier with arrows, the question, the pick or error badge and "n of N answered" with a bar.

examples.title: Library page: page crumb, no round tier
A round that could not be loaded

provenance.note: "D is clean but also C has some nice two tiers approach and bar with "x of y answered" .  Also those icons  in D on the right are nice! meaning they look good but seems like here is a bad place for them cuz they are tooo small ?" Applied: D's breadcrumb and round menu, C's round tier, D's icons made bigger in round-002.
"< and > icons should be slightly bigger. other then dat. perfect" Applied: 20px arrow icons in 36px buttons.

rules: Two tiers. Top bar: breadcrumb taste-lab / <name> / <round menu>; the round segment opens a menu of every round with its status (round-001 mix, round-002 b).
Round tier on Compare pages only: prev and next, the question, the pick or error badge, "n of N answered" with a bar (round-001 mix, round-002 b).
Page nav as icon-only outline toggles with names in tooltips, 40px tall with 20px icons (round-002 b).
Round arrows: 20px icons in 36px buttons (round-002 b).
Off Compare, the breadcrumb names the page and the round tier is hidden (round-002 b).
Never list every round as a button in the header (round-001 a).
Don't shrink page icons to fit (round-001 d).
